searchText: Is it safe to double our `miner.gaslimit` on our goerli validator now or should we do it closer to the goerli fork? <@!388751025789468672> I imagine closer to the goerli fork, because if you do it now you will actually start raising the limit 2x. I don't think there's an automated way to double it at a specific block, right? Difficulty bomb update, courtesy of <@!334288075356241920>: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/245#issuecomment-866193842 Pretty relevant to London timing. It'd be good if clients could have a look and share their thoughts about the pros/cons of forking past block 13m on ACD this Friday.
